_comment: Description and badge transcribed from the in-game Custom Search screen with this mode selected, captured 2026-08-05 (Steam capture 20260805231923).
name: Obliteration
_alias_note: The "obliteration" alias also matches Tactical Obliteration, which is a separate mode added in 1.3.3.0. Check the tag before accepting an auto-tagged line.

description.text: Fight to control neutral bombs, arm them on enemy M-COMs, and destroy multiple M-COMs to win.

_tag_deny_note: Tactical Obliteration is a separate mode added in 1.3.3.0. A line naming only that one must not land here; a line naming both still matches on the bare name.
_art_note: Art is the little badge the game prints beside GAME MODE on the Custom Search screen, not a scene, so it renders at icon size rather than filling the art column. Cut from the same capture as the description.
